slices.focus: Converting the crate damage into mandatory outgoing loan controls using a blunt incident packet
slices.summary: Hannah assembles an incident packet (shipping photos, email timestamps, repair estimates, missing signoff trail) that forces a new policy: no outgoing loan crate moves without written registrar approval, a current condition report, and a complete packing worksheet.
open_loops: Draft one-page release checklist with three non-negotiables
Schedule short training session (15-20 min walkthrough of stop points)
Create release sheet that physically cannot be closed without three attachments
Prepare script for first deadline collision
decisions: Hannah remains registrar and turned the damaged crate incident into stricter outgoing loan controls requiring documented
